bullets: Diagnosed and resolved 1000+ geospatial data defects in Apple Maps' production pipeline using Linux-based log analysis, improving routing accuracy and POI integrity at global scale. Investigated system logs to resolve performance and configuration problems.

Automated daily validation workflows with Python and Bash/shell scripting. Built and maintained a Python-based automated test framework that ran daily validation of production data, managed regression runs, and surfaced defect trends for cross-functional triage.
